text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a maximum 15-minute pick-up/drop-off area on the south side of Gerrard Street East, between George Street and Pembroke Street, to allow parents and guardians to pick-up and drop-off passengers attending the Gerrard Early Learning Centre located at No.163 Gerrard Street East.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing standing prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Gerrard Street East, between a point 31.5 metres east of George Street and a point 5.5 metres further east. 2. Amended the stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Gerrard Street East, between George Street and a point 15 metres east, to be in effect from George Street to a point 24 metres east. 3. Amended the existing pay-and-display parking in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Saturday, and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Sunday, at a rate of $2.00 per hour for a maximum period of 3 hours, on the south side of Gerrard Street East, between a point 37 metres east of George Street and a point 51 metres west of Sherbourne Street, to be in effect…
